tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi gtor dbang yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi gtor dbang yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po 'bri gung par grags pa// yab sras bzhed pa'i phyag len ni// mthong rgyud ji bzhin 'dir bshad kyi// mos ldan yod na dga' bas longs// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan la gnad du song ba'i slob dpon gyis slob ma snod ldan la lnga ldan gyi gtor dbang bskur na/ dri bzang gis sbags pa'i stegs bu'i dbus su mañji'i steng du rin po che'i snod gas chag med par zlum gtor pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa'i steng du dar gdugs dang bcas pa'i g.yas su/ bum pa mgul chings lnga ldan nang bcud so lnga'i nang chus sum gnyis bkang ba kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ g.yon du thod pa mtshan ldan chang bzang po la a mṛ ta btab pa kha dar dmar gyis bcad pa/ de rnams kyi mdun du bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi gtor ma dang*/ de dag gi mdun du chu bzhi nyer spyod bsham/ tshogs rdzas 'du bya/ slob dpon khrus bya| gzhi bgegs la gtor ma btang*/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun sogs 'og nas dbang gi skabs su 'byung ba ltar byas rjes/ mchod pa nang mchod bde mchog ltar byin brlabs| bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i ra gur 'jigs dus kyi me ltar 'bar ba me ri dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ bdag dang gtor ma skad cig gis rdzogs pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog mthing nag /zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i thor cog gi rtse mor nor bu dang mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon du zla ba phyed pas spras shing mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ thod skam lnga rin po che'i rtse phran can dar dpyangs dang bcas pas dpral ba'i steng du bcings
